meta: Online romance scams: a sweet stranger chats for weeks, then suddenly has an emergency and asks for money.

muc.title: Sweet talk, then money
muc.text: A stranger online chats sweetly for weeks, then suddenly has an emergency and needs you to send money.

muc.title: Never meeting in person
muc.text: The common signs: getting close very fast, always avoiding meeting, then asking for money or pitching an investment.

muc.title: Reread the chat
muc.text: Remove names and phone numbers, paste the chat into a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, and ask it to point out emotionally manipulative lines.

muc.title: Don't be ashamed
muc.text: If you've already sent money, don't be ashamed. Call your bank, report it to the police, and tell your family.

muc.title: Share with your family
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to list five common money requests in romance scams, then share them in your family group.
